label: SIMULATED: no agent or model runs. Each case passes with a probability set per slice in the experiment file, drawn from seeded random numbers. The probabilities and the case share are chosen to teach, not measured.
seed_note: Chosen so that run 0, the release run, shows the 2-point gain the probabilities build in (81 and 83 of 100). Other runs show other gaps.
case_share_note: How much of a pass or fail belongs to the case itself, shared by every run and both versions. The rest is fresh luck in each run. 0 makes every run independent; 1 makes the agent deterministic.
